title: Slimline GPU Pool Inspector: Compact Health + Autoscale Controls with KV-awareness
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Design a compact, single-row inspector for Dedicated GPU pools that surfaces critical health signals (utilization, queue depth, tail latency), KV cache effectiveness, and quick autoscale/burst controls. This view is intended for SREs and platform engineers who need a tight summary in the pool list and a tappable mini-inspector from the pool details page.

Scope: prototype a responsive mini-panel (desktop and tablet widths) that: shows current capacity and a utilization sparkline, highlights anomalous signals (spike alerts), exposes KV cache hit rate with quick filter, and provides inline autoscale adjustments (target replicas, burst window, and an emergency 'instant-burst' action). Include accessible micro-interactions and keyboard support for the inline controls.

Design decisions so far: compact layout uses a left compact pill for pool name + tier, a central sparkline + numeric KPIs (util %, qps, p99 latency), and a right-side control rail with an inline slider for target replicas plus a small overflow menu for advanced config. KV cache is surfaced as a horizontal micro-bar with tooltip showing prefix/key hit-rate and last-eviction time. We intentionally limit the number of primary controls to avoid accidental scaling changes; destructive actions require a two-step confirmation.

Trade-offs: we deprioritized embedding full trace links in the inspector to keep the row height small; instead we provide a contextual link to the traces panel. We also chose a discrete step slider (1 replica increments) to avoid fractional capacity adjustments; team requested finer control during reviews — decided to expose fine-grain control in the advanced modal only.

Prototypes and artifacts are linked below. This ticket covers visual spec, interaction flows, and a high-fidelity Figma prototype for engineering handoff. Engineering tickets will split the autopilot/heuristics integration and API surface (ENG-19876) and the backend KV metrics endpoint (ENG-20490).
acceptance_criteria: Mini-inspector renders at pool-list row height (max 72px) and matches pixel spec in Figma at 1024px width
Shows real-time values for util %, qps, p99 latency, and KV cache hit rate; tooltips show 24h delta
Autoscale slider allows adjusting target replicas inline; changes call the /api/pools/:id/scale endpoint and surface success/error states
Instant-burst action triggers a preflight confirmation and records an audit event (console logs + UI toast)
When an anomalous signal (util > 85% or p99 > SLO) is detected, the inspector highlights the metric and exposes a suggested action card
Keyboard accessible: focus order, aria labels, and operable slider, menu, and confirmation dialogs
Design handoff includes component tokens, spacing, and accessible color variants in the Figma file
